clues.text: This small commune sits on the east bank of the Dniester River in Moldova. It is the chief town of its district, near the land's east edge.
clues.narrowing: rules out everything outside Moldova on the east bank of the Dniester River

source.quote: Cocieri is a commune in the Republic of Moldova, and the administrative center of Dubăsari District. It is located on the eastern bank of the Dniester River, consisting of two villages, Cocieri and Vasilievca.

clues.text: In winter, ice on the river stops the ferry. It is the only direct link to the rest of its own country.
clues.narrowing: rules out places in mild-winter regions where rivers do not freeze enough to stop ferries

source.quote: The village can only be reached directly from Moldova proper by ferry, which does not run during winter due to ice on the river.

clues.text: In the 1992 war, the folk here rose up and fought the breakaway side. When the war ended, this place stayed part of Moldova.
clues.narrowing: rules out Moldovan river places that did not rebel in the 1992 war and stay with Moldova

source.quote: During 1992 War of Transnistria inhabitants of this village rebelled against the separatist authorities of Transnistria. The military unit of the 14th former Soviet Army which was located in the village was attacked by local inhabitants who armed themselves and opposed the forces of Transnistria. As result, after the war, Cocieri remained in the area controlled by the Republic of Moldova.

clues.text: Roads out of town pass checkpoints run by breakaway leaders. They charge a fee for each crossing out of the commune.
clues.narrowing: rules out almost every other Moldovan commune, which has no breakaway-run checkpoints charging fees

source.quote: Transnistrian authorities control checkpoints on roads out of the commune and charge fees for crossing it.

clues.text: Just two small villages make up this commune on the Dniester River. This one is the chief town of its whole district.
clues.narrowing: confirms the two-village district centre on the Dniester River in Moldova
